pricing_faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
pricing_faq.description: Get answers to common questions about our pricing plans and credits system

support.title: Have more questions? We're here to help
support.description: Can't find the answer you're looking for? Our support team is ready to assist you.

questions.question: What are credits and how do they work?
questions.answer: 10 credits generate 1 high-quality image. Credits are automatically refilled at the start of each billing cycle - monthly for monthly plans, all at once for yearly plans. One-time credit packs never expire.

questions.question: Can I change my plan anytime?
questions.answer: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Upgrades take effect immediately, while downgrades take effect at the next billing cycle. Your current credits will remain available.

questions.question: Do unused credits roll over?
questions.answer: Monthly plan credits do not roll over to the next month. Yearly plan credits are valid for the entire subscription period. One-time credit packs never expire. We recommend choosing a plan based on your actual usage needs.

questions.question: What payment methods are supported?
questions.answer: We support credit cards, debit cards, and various other payment methods through Stripe. All payments are processed securely through our trusted payment partners.

questions.question: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
questions.answer: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time. You'll continue to have access to your plan benefits until the end of your current billing period. For assistance with cancellation, please contact our support team.

questions.question: What's the difference between monthly and yearly plans?
questions.answer: Yearly plans offer significant savings - up to 20% off compared to monthly billing. Monthly plans give you flexibility with month-to-month commitment, while yearly plans provide better value for long-term users.

questions.question: How do one-time credit packs work?
questions.answer: One-time credit packs are perfect if you don't need regular monthly credits. You pay once and get credits that never expire. These are ideal for occasional users or those who want to try our service without a subscription.

questions.question: What happens if I run out of credits?
questions.answer: If you run out of credits, you can either wait for your next billing cycle (for subscription plans) or purchase additional one-time credit packs. You can also upgrade your plan to get more monthly credits.

questions.question: Are there any hidden fees?
questions.answer: No, there are no hidden fees. The price you see is exactly what you'll pay. All taxes and processing fees are clearly shown during checkout before you complete your purchase.

questions.question: Can I use generated images commercially?
questions.answer: Yes, all our paid plans include commercial usage rights. You can use the AI-generated images for business purposes, marketing, social media, and other commercial applications. Free trial images may have usage restrictions.

sora2VsVeo3.title: Sora 2 vs Veo 3 — Model Comparison
sora2VsVeo3.description: Sora 2 API and Veo 3 are advanced AI video generation models available in 2025. Sora 2 focuses on flexible text-to-video and image-to-video generation with strong creative control, physics consistency, and HD output. Veo 3 emphasizes realism and audio-visual synchronization, offering up to 1080p resolution and native audio. Developers may prefer Sora 2 for customizable, narrative-driven content and easy API integration. Veo 3 is better suited for high-fidelity, realistic video production through Google's Gemini API ecosystem.
sora2VsVeo3.veo3AudioGeneration: Produces native audio with lip-sync and ambient sound (less detailed laye)
sora2VsVeo3.sora2PromptAdherence: High controllability; good for stylized/narrative; improved physics
sora2VsVeo3.veo3PromptAdherence: High realism; accurate lighting and A/V sync; less flexible
